contract_answer.question: Does removing the explicit r_d, r_c capacity-ratio fade inputs worsen the GateRepair parent enough across the three paper splits to credit the fade component?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independent recomputation from the 600 selected-checkpoint predictions (epoch 11) gives split-2021 MAPE 0.083483, Acc@15 0.8117, RMSE 20.280 cycles, bias -10.903, prediction/target std 19.31/20.28, versus NA-E009 MAPE 0.099874, Acc@15 0.7433, RMSE 22.528, bias -15.908, std 15.21/20.28 (delta MAPE -0.016391). Prefix bands (ablation vs parent): 01-10 0.1329 vs 0.1221; 11-25 0.0852 vs 0.0936; 26-50 0.0850 vs 0.0928; 51-75 0.0746 vs 0.0932; 76-100 0.0700 vs 0.1085. Per-cell MAPE: 1-6-59 0.0454 vs 0.0978; 3-2-55 0.1422 vs 0.1567; 3-4-53 0.0737 vs 0.0937; 4-2-47 0.1426 vs 0.1473; 4-6-43 0.0628 vs 0.0533; 5-5-35 0.0342 vs 0.0504. Family 3-split MAPE 0.129589 +/- 0.054465 (sample std) versus parent 0.108654 +/- 0.008549; mean delta +0.020936, meeting the +0.008 credit threshold, so the component is credited.

main_symptom: Split 2021: ablation MAPE 0.0835 vs parent 0.0999 (-0.0164); family mean +0.0209 worse than parent with sample std 0.0545. Diagnostics are finite, padding-invariant, with overall_gradient_health=WARNING from branch imbalance (ext_da/tcn_norm ratio 2.21e+06).

causes.interpretation: The capacity-ratio fade state carries degradation-level information the curve encoder and TCN do not recover reliably; without it the network underestimates spread (prediction std shrinks) on the hardest split. This split is a counterexample: removal improves MAPE by -0.0164, but the family mean is still +0.0209 worse.
missing_evidence: Repeated-seed variance within each locked split

causes.interpretation: With six validation cells per split and one seed, the family mean is dominated by split 42 (+0.0727); split 2021 improves and split 2024 worsens only slightly, so the credit rests largely on one split.
missing_evidence: Matched reruns with different initialization seeds on the same locked splits
